description: CR 728.1a the loss from radiation becomes a gain, and damage on the same board still takes life
note: Strong, the Brutish Thespian turns life loss from radiation into a gain (CR 614.6). Two counters mill two Lightning Bolts over a Mountain, so 20 becomes 22; bob's Lightning Bolt then deals 3 under the same row, and damage is not radiation (CR 120.4c), so 22 becomes 19. Without the second loss the case would pass on a rewrite that never looked at the cause. The Haskell test applied the 3 damage directly from a Goblin Piker; bob's Bolt is the same noncombat 3.
